title: Narrow child capability envelopes without silent inheritance
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He binds a parent capability envelope in the environment, runs `capability_envelope` to narrow a child and attempt a widen, and verifies the child stays a subset while widen raises and delegation prefers child.
implementation: `CapabilityEnvelope.narrow` plus `DefaultDelegationPolicy`. Story `environment.capability_envelope` binds Config `get_capability_envelope`; product verb `capability_envelope` exercises narrow/widen.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `capability_envelope_narrow.yaml` drives `capability_envelope`; expects narrow_ok / child_grant_count / widen_raises / delegation_choice.
